Description:
Key Storage Provider interface.
Notes:
Any object is uniquely identified by the combination of its GUID and type.
HSMs/TPMs implementing the concept of "non-extractable keys" should use own copies of
externally supplied crypto objects.
A few software Crypto Providers can share single key slot if they support same format.
